title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Technical Customer Service Administrator

Location: East Anglia

Salary: Competitive Salary + Excellent Benefits

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an organised and detail-oriented Technical Customer Service Administrator to join a successful engineering and manufacturing business.

This is a varied and fast-paced role supporting the processing of technical enquiries, quotations and customer orders. Working closely with engineering, commercial and project teams, you'll play a key role in ensuring customer requirements are accurately interpreted, recorded and progressed through the business.

This is not a traditional customer service position. The role is ideally suited to someone who enjoys working with technical information, engineering documentation and business systems while providing a high standard of customer support.

The Role

As a Technical Customer Service Administrator, your responsibilities will include:
- Managing customer enquiries and purchase orders from receipt through to processing.
- Reviewing technical specifications, drawings and supporting documentation to ensure information is complete and accurate.
- Processing enquiries, quotations and customer orders using ERP and CRM systems.
- Maintaining accurate customer, quotation and order records.
- Supporting the smooth progression of enquiries throughout the business.
- Liaising with internal engineering, estimating, contracts and commercial teams.
- Responding to customer queries and providing updates on order progress.
- Identifying missing or incomplete information and resolving documentation queries.
- Supporting document control and maintaining accurate technical records.
- Ensuring all work is completed in line with company procedures and quality standards.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining administration, technical information and customer communication within an engineering environment.

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, methodical and enjoys working with accuracy and attention to detail.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within an engineering, manufacturing or technical office environment.
- Experience in customer service, sales support, order processing or technical administration.
- Experience working with ERP and CRM systems.
- Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications or technical documentation.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication skills with a professional and customer-focused approach.
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.

Knowledge of engineering products or manufacturing processes would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary.
- Company pension.
- Hybrid working
- Ongoing training and development.
- Stable and supportive working environment.
- Long-term career opportunities.
- Modern office environment.
- Opportunity to work alongside experienced engineering professionals.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join an established engineering business where accuracy, teamwork and customer service are highly valued.

You'll become an important part of a collaborative team, working closely with engineering and commercial colleagues to ensure customers receive an efficient and professional service while developing valuable technical knowledge along the way.

If you're looking for a technical administration role within an engineering environment where you can build a long-term career, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now for a confidential discussion.

title: Student Administration Assistant
description:
Student Administration Assistant

9 month FTC

26,500 pro rata

Norwich City Centre

Fully Office Based, Monday - Friday

We're looking for a confident, organised and people-focused individual to join a busy and supportive education team during one of their busiest periods of the year.

This role plays a key part in supporting students as they begin their apprenticeship journey, helping to create a positive and professional experience from day one. You'll be welcoming students, coordinating assessments, assisting with enrolments and providing essential administrative support to ensure everything runs smoothly.

Why This Role?

You'll be at the heart of the student experience, greeting learners, supporting exam administration, helping with apprenticeship onboarding and ensuring students receive a warm and professional welcome.

Some days you may be supporting just a handful of students, while on others you could be welcoming over 100 people through the doors. It's a varied role that would suit someone who enjoys working with people, building relationships and keeping organised in a fast-paced environment.

You'll be joining a friendly, collaborative team where support is always available, making it a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys customer-facing work and wants to gain experience within education and training.

What You'll Be Doing

Student Support & Customer Service
- Acting as a first point of contact for students attending the centre
- Providing a professional and welcoming experience for all visitors
- Responding to student enquiries via email and occasional telephone calls

Exam & Apprenticeship Administration
- Assisting with the scheduling and coordination of examinations
- Invigilating exams and ensuring procedures are followed
- Helping enrol students onto apprenticeship programmes

Operations & Administration
- Maintaining accurate records and updating internal systems
- Supporting the production of student progress reports
- Managing general administrative tasks and document processing

What We're Looking For
- Previous administration or customer service experience
- Strong face-to-face communication skills
- Confidence interacting with large groups of people
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Comfortable using IT systems and Microsoft Office

Nice to Have
- Experience within education, training or apprenticeships
- Previous exam invigilation or administration experience
- Experience working in a busy customer facing environment

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. title: Customer Service Coordinator
description:
Join Our Team at Smurfit Westrock!

Are you searching for a workplace that values you and your growth? At Smurfit Westrock, we re committed to sustainability, employee well-being, and personal development.

About Us

We are a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging. Our focus is on the health and safety of our employees, the well-being of our communities, and delivering exceptional service to our customers. We support our team members to reach their full potential in an inclusive environment that values diversity.

The Role

Here at Smurfit Westrock Diss, we are looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to join our internal sales team on a full time basis, working 8.30am-5pm

Reporting to the Customer Service Manager, this is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in customer service and develop their commercial and business skills within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

As part of our Customer Service team, you'll be the first point of contact for customers, providing exceptional service while working closely with colleagues across sales, production and logistics. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of business activities, making this an ideal role for someone who enjoys learning, building relationships and taking on new challenges.

What we're looking for:
- A positive, proactive attitude and eagerness to learn.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workload.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- A professional approach and willingness to take ownership of tasks and customer enquiries.
- Resilience and the ability to remain calm in a busy environment.

In return, you'll have the opportunity to develop valuable commercial, customer service and business administration skills as part of a supportive and collaborative team.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary & benefits, including annual leave, pension, and a Cycle to Work scheme
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
- 24/7 confidential support for you and your family
- Flexible working options and family-friendly policies
- Guaranteed interview for candidates meeting essential criteria (Disability Confident Employer)

Ready to make an impact? Apply today and help us build a sustainable future together.
